title: Restriction to an open preserves K-injective complexes
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open inclusion. For a complex $I^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] that is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex], the termwise restriction $j^{-1}I^\bullet$ is K-injective as a complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules.
